what_it_does: Start a fresh copy first, move traffic to it, then stop the bad one (no downtime)
how: kubectl rollout restart deployment/<svc> (surge 1, unavailable 0) | docker: start replica, then restart
verify_by: Service and its callers back to baseline for 16 s

what_it_does: Stop and start the same instance (short downtime)
how: kubectl delete pod <pod> | docker restart <ctr>

what_it_does: Add replicas so load is shared
how: kubectl scale deployment/<svc> --replicas=N+k (or raise HPA max)
verify_by: Latency and saturation back under target

what_it_does: Remove the extra replicas once load is normal
how: kubectl scale deployment/<svc> --replicas=<baseline>

what_it_does: Give the container more memory/CPU (buys time, does not fix a leak)
how: kubectl set resources deployment/<svc> --limits=memory=...

what_it_does: Return to the last version that worked
how: kubectl rollout undo deployment/<svc> | docker: run previous image tag

what_it_does: Stop a rollout half-way so no more pods get the bad version
how: kubectl rollout pause deployment/<svc> | Argo Rollouts abort
verify_by: No new pods on the bad version

what_it_does: Restore the previous ConfigMap / env var / flag / port / probe
how: kubectl rollout undo, or re-apply the last known-good manifest

what_it_does: Disable the code path that fails without redeploying
how: flag service / ConfigMap edit

what_it_does: Delete temp files, rotate and compress old logs
how: exec into pod: remove tmp, logrotate | docker exec
verify_by: Disk share falls and stops rising

what_it_does: Grow the persistent volume
how: edit PVC storage request (StorageClass must allow expansion)

what_it_does: Reject excess requests early so the rest succeed
how: ingress / gateway rate limit, or app load-shedding switch
verify_by: Error rate on admitted requests falls

what_it_does: Callers stop waiting on a failing dependency and fail fast or use a fallback
how: service-mesh outlier detection / app breaker

what_it_does: Shorter timeouts, capped retries with backoff and jitter (stops retry storms)
how: config change, needs a rollout
verify_by: Load on the slow dependency falls

fix: Move the pod to another node
what_it_does: Reschedule away from a noisy or broken node
how: kubectl cordon <node>; kubectl delete pod <pod> (or drain)

what_it_does: Stop the query that blocks or overloads the database
how: SELECT pg_cancel_backend(pid) / KILL QUERY

fix: Shift reads to a replica / cache
what_it_does: Take read load off the primary database
how: app config / proxy routing

what_it_does: Allow more connections or open files
how: config change (pool size, ulimit -n, max_connections) + rollout

what_it_does: Bring CoreDNS back or add DNS replicas
how: kubectl -n kube-system rollout restart deployment/coredns; scale coredns

what_it_does: Remove the policy that blocks or breaks traffic
how: kubectl delete / edit networkpolicy or mesh policy

what_it_does: Send traffic to healthy instances / another zone
how: load balancer or mesh weights

what_it_does: Hand over with the evidence; no automatic change
how: Telegram / pager message with incident report
